title: 3 Research Papers Accepted for Presentation at COMOSA 2026 (Springer SOIA)
title_vi: 3 Công trình Nghiên cứu được chấp thuận Báo cáo tại Hội thảo Quốc tế COMOSA 2026 (Springer SOIA)
summary: SLSCM Lab achieves triple acceptance at the 1st International Conference on Optimization, Modeling, Simulation, and Analytics (COMOSA 2026), featuring breakthrough works on drone tourism routing, energy-constrained parallel scheduling, and drone-locker urban logistics.
summary_en: SLSCM Lab achieves triple acceptance at the 1st International Conference on Optimization, Modeling, Simulation, and Analytics (COMOSA 2026), featuring breakthrough works on drone tourism routing, energy-constrained parallel scheduling, and drone-locker urban logistics.
summary_vi: SLSCM Lab ghi dấu ấn với 3 công trình nghiên cứu được chấp nhận báo cáo tại Hội thảo Quốc tế COMOSA 2026, bao gồm các chủ đề về định tuyến drone du lịch, lập lịch máy song song tiết kiệm năng lượng và định vị tủ khóa drone thông minh.
content_en:
We are pleased to announce that 3 papers by SLSCM Lab researchers and collaborators have been officially accepted for presentation at COMOSA 2026 (August 7–8, 2026 in Hanoi, Vietnam) and publication in Springer SOIA proceedings:

• Paper #31: "Drone Tourism Routing Under Energy, Time-Window and Communication-Coverage Constraints" — Cao Nguyet Anh, Vu Duc Minh, Le Thi Bich Hanh, Pham Thanh Binh
• Paper #33: "Improved Bounds for the Energy-Constrained Parallel Machine Scheduling Problem to Minimize Total Completion Time" — Viet Nguyen Huu, Tien Thanh Mai, Quy Ta Dinh, Minh Hoang Ha, Binh Huynh Thi Thanh
• Paper #36: "On the Drone-Locker Location Scheduling Problem" — Thi Nhung Tran, Thu Trang Hoa, Hai Dang Le, Minh Hoang Ha
content_vi:
SLSCM Lab vui mừng thông báo 3 công trình nghiên cứu của các thành viên và cộng tác viên Lab đã chính thức được chấp thuận trình bày tại COMOSA 2026 (ngày 7–8/8/2026 tại Hà Nội) và xuất bản trong Kỷ yếu Springer SOIA:

• Bài #31: "Drone Tourism Routing Under Energy, Time-Window and Communication-Coverage Constraints" — Cao Nguyệt Ánh, TS. Vũ Đức Minh, Lê Thị Bích Hạnh, Phạm Thanh Bình
• Bài #33: "Improved Bounds for the Energy-Constrained Parallel Machine Scheduling Problem to Minimize Total Completion Time" — Nguyễn Hữu Việt, PGS. TS. Mai Tiến Thành, ThS. Tạ Đình Quý, PGS. TS. Hà Minh Hoàng, PGS. TS. Huỳnh Thị Thanh Bình
• Bài #36: "On the Drone-Locker Location Scheduling Problem" — Trần Thị Nhung, Hoa Thu Trang, Lê Hải Đăng, PGS. TS. Hà Minh Hoàng

title: SLSCM Lab Researchers Publish in Premier Journal Transportation Research Part C (TRC, 2026)
title_vi: SLSCM Lab Researchers Publish in Premier Journal Transportation Research Part C (TRC, 2026)
summary: Our research team, featuring young researcher Tran Nam Khanh (HUS-VNU) and Dr. Duc Minh Vu, officially published their paper on Stage-Based Formulations and Matheuristic Algorithms for the Revisit Flying Sidekick TSP in TRC (Vol. 192).
summary_en: Our research team, featuring young researcher Tran Nam Khanh (HUS-VNU) and Dr. Duc Minh Vu, officially published their paper on Stage-Based Formulations and Matheuristic Algorithms for the Revisit Flying Sidekick TSP in TRC (Vol. 192).
content_en: This research introduces the Revisit Flying Sidekick Traveling Salesman Problem (RV-FSTSP), relaxing rigid classical constraints to permit delivery trucks to revisit previously served customers and operate as stationary launchpads for multiple successive drone sorties. Comprehensive computational experiments prove our matheuristic saves up to 28.4% of total mission makespan.

title: Major Research Milestone: Publication Accepted by INFORMS Journal on Computing (IJOC)
title_vi: Major Research Milestone: Publication Accepted by INFORMS Journal on Computing (IJOC)
summary: Paper by Le Ba Luat, Prof. Mai Tien (SMU), Dr. Ta Thuy Anh, Assoc. Prof. Minh Hoang Ha, and Dr. Duc Minh Vu on Competitive Facility Location under Cross-Nested Logit models officially accepted by Area Editor Andrea Lodi.
summary_en: Paper by Le Ba Luat, Prof. Mai Tien (SMU), Dr. Ta Thuy Anh, Assoc. Prof. Minh Hoang Ha, and Dr. Duc Minh Vu on Competitive Facility Location under Cross-Nested Logit models officially accepted by Area Editor Andrea Lodi.
content_en: INFORMS Journal on Computing is a premier flagship journal in operations research and computing. The paper resolves a longstanding mathematical challenge: establishing NP-hardness proofs and transforming the non-concave objective into a mixed-integer exponential cone convex program solved to optimality via outer approximation. Open-source solvers and benchmark datasets have been integrated into the IJOC Software Repository.

title: Scholars Win Fully-Funded PhD & Research Positions at Singapore Management University (SMU)

summary_en: Ba Luat Le (Valedictorian) secured a full PhD scholarship in Operations Research at SMU, while former scholar Thu Trang Hoa joined as a Research Engineer in Computing & AI.
content_en: This milestone highlights the lab's dedication to nurturing young scholars and aligning with global academic standards. Under joint mentorship by Prof. Mai Tien (SMU), Assoc. Prof. Minh Hoang Ha, and Dr. Duc Minh Vu, our scholars build top-tier publication records before entering prestigious doctoral and research engineering programs.

title: Inter-Lab Initiative: AI & OR for Hanoi Urban Smart Water Supply & Drainage Network
title_vi: Inter-Lab Initiative: AI & OR for Hanoi Urban Smart Water Supply & Drainage Network
summary: Kick-off of an interdisciplinary project between CADA Lab (P1601) and SLSCM Lab (P1613) at College of Technology - NEU to optimize municipal water infrastructure via AI and Operations Research.
summary_en: Kick-off of an interdisciplinary project between CADA Lab (P1601) and SLSCM Lab (P1613) at College of Technology - NEU to optimize municipal water infrastructure via AI and Operations Research.
content_en: The interdisciplinary project integrates real-time IoT hydraulic sensor feeds across Hanoi with deep learning predictive models and mixed-integer nonlinear programming for pump station optimization, significantly curbing energy consumption and bolstering flood defense capabilities.

title: Executive Workshop: From Data to Decision Intelligence & Prescriptive Analytics
title_vi: Executive Workshop: From Data to Decision Intelligence & Prescriptive Analytics
summary: SLSCM Lab and FDA College of Technology hosted an intensive 4-module professional course on mathematical modeling, Python solvers (Gurobi, OR-Tools), and supply chain optimization.
summary_en: SLSCM Lab and FDA College of Technology hosted an intensive 4-module professional course on mathematical modeling, Python solvers (Gurobi, OR-Tools), and supply chain optimization.
content_en: More than 50 participants, including talented undergraduates, graduate students, and analytics specialists from retail and logistics enterprises, attended. The intensive 4-module program provided hands-on training in MIP modeling, Python solvers (Gurobi, Google OR-Tools), and supply chain decision intelligence.
